items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: And so he, I think, uh, their first job, which was, uh, Tom Brown's band was with Joe Frisco.

ctx.x: Until they had that come back in 1936 or so. Yeah.

Uh huh. Then after that, he didn't play anymore. Yeah. Didn't play at all after that. No. He just retired, but, uh, he lived out in, uh, Hollywood. But every night, uh, I understand he'd go over and see Joe Rushkin, who was a very good friend of his. Joe was working at the Brown Derby, I think was Red Nickels. Yeah. And he'd always go around and see the guys, you know, and listen. And, uh, as I understand, he, he and Joe Frisco would sit around and talk to him.
